_doc: Băng Tâm Các signature items and sets (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Unpriced proposals: modifier sizes follow the ice catalogue's grade 3-4 items; Effects are hand-written rules, unpriced.

items.name: Jade Vessel of the Ice Heart (Băng Tâm Ngọc Hồ)

effects.name: Ice in the Vessel (Băng Tại Ngọc Hồ)
effects.rule: While you are Composed, your frost ward regains 2 % of its value each second; heart-demon odds at a breakthrough fall by a third while the Vessel is worn.

items.lore: A plain jade wine vessel holding a piece of ice that has not melted since 440. The founder carried the Ice-Heart Canon across the desert inside it. Legendary item bang_tam_ngoc_ho.
items.build_use: The Keeper's sustain piece: linh lực and a ward that thickens while she stays Composed.

items.name: Frost Seal of the Pavilion (Băng Tâm Các Sương Ấn)
items.lore: The seal every writ of the Pavilion has borne since 470; the frost it stamps stays on paper for a year.
items.build_use: The Keeper's offence: Cold damage and heavier Ice stacks.

items.name: Clear-Heart Mirror (Băng Tâm Kính)

effects.name: Clear-Heart Reflection (Băng Tâm Phản Chiếu)
effects.rule: Once a fight, the first soul or heart-demon art cast on you is reflected on its caster as Cold damage equal to its own.

items.lore: A disc of lake ice polished for a century and sealed in silver; who looks in it sees their heart without its feelings.
items.build_use: Defence against soul arts; the array keeper's guard while she holds a seal.

items.name: White Plum (Bạch Mai Kiếm)
items.lore: The white of Lãnh Hương Các's two plum swords: a pale blade that smells of plum blossom when it cuts.
items.build_use: A Snow Plum duelist's sword: crit and Ice stacks.

items.name: Red Plum (Hồng Mai Kiếm)
items.lore: The red of the pair, dark as old blood, lost at Cô Thành in 726. Phó Ám Hương believes Phượng Minh Cung keeps it.
items.build_use: The pair's heavy blade: crit damage and pierce.
items.where: Phượng Minh Cung's Hall of Spoils, under the head's keys (confirmed in the cross-sect pass; phuong_minh §10)

items.name: Ice-Hole Blade (Băng Huyệt Đao)
items.lore: A broad fisher's ice-cutter Thẩm Hàn Giang had reforged into a sword when he reached Nguyên Anh; the coast gave the steel.
items.build_use: A long-fight sword: health and leech under Cold hits.

items.name: Glazed Frost (Lưu Ly Sương Kiếm)
items.lore: So clear you can read through it. The Keeper gave it to her first disciple at her Kết Đan.
items.build_use: Pure Ice duelling: stack effect and crit.

items.name: Frost Lotus Banner (Sương Liên Kỳ)
items.lore: The banner planted at the Array's eye in 820, when the last nodes were laid, white silk with one frost lotus that has never wilted. Cố carried it up Băng Bích Nhai when she went into seclusion and planted it again outside her cave.
items.build_use: The array keeper's banner: Ice stacks that stay, linh lực to hold the seal.

items.name: Glacier Bastion Plate (Băng Bích Lũy Giáp)
items.lore: Plates of blue glacier ice cut from the wall of her own cave in 1010 and bound in silver wire; it does not melt while she breathes beside it.
items.build_use: The glacier bastion: health and a heavy body shield behind the seal.

items.name: Seal of the Last Order (Di Mệnh Ấn)
items.lore: A black stone seal Tần Ngưng Sương pressed into Cố's palm on her deathbed in 1010, with an order no one else has heard. The stone is from Hồ Thiên's ruin under the seat.
items.build_use: Earth formation power and guard stacks: the seal she fights inside.

items.name: Seal-Oil Coat (Hải Báo Du Giáp)
items.lore: Sealskin boiled in its own oil in a Liên Giang yard, the gift of Đoàn Thanh Lãng's family the winter the two men swore brotherhood on the ice.
items.build_use: A brawler's coat: health and regeneration for the long fight.

items.name: Gourd of Coast Wine (Ngạn Tửu Hồ)
items.lore: A fisher's wine gourd that the Hall of Cold Law's master never lets empty. The frost-coast villages refill it for him and call it their tax paid in kind.
items.build_use: Sustain between plum cuts: linh lực and health regeneration.

items.name: Seal of the Hundred and Eight Nodes (Bách Bát Tiết Ấn)
items.lore: Cut from locust wood of Hòe Âm and carved with all 108 nodes of the Jade Vessel Array; she presses it to each node on her walk.
items.build_use: The node walker's formation seal: Earth guard and linh lực.

items.name: Locust-Wood Lid (Hòe Mộc Cái)
items.lore: A round shield of the same locust tree, shaped like the lid of the Array's well. Thái Lê Tuyết sent the wood from Hòe Âm in 822.
items.build_use: A seal-keeper's shield: block and status resistance while she stays Composed.

items.name: Cape of Phó Thanh Mai (Thanh Mai Phi Phong)
items.lore: The plum-blossom swordsman's cape that a Băng Tâm soldier wrapped the four-year-old boy in at Cô Thành, with the red-ink Snow Plum manual sewn into its lining. He wears it with the lining still open.
items.build_use: The third piece of the Plums: health and evasion for a sword that gives up its block.

items.name: Frost Star Ring (Sương Tinh Giới)
items.lore: A ring of ice the Keeper set with five frost stars at Khương's Kết Đan; Khương counts the stars before every duel.
items.build_use: Pure Ice duelling: stack effect and crit.

items.name: Ink-Frost Robe (Mặc Sương Bào)
items.lore: A white robe on which Khương brushed the whole of the Ice-Heart Canon in frost ink; the characters fade in summer and come back each winter.
items.build_use: Guard for a duelist who wears no plate.

items.name: The Winter Robe (Hàn Y)
items.lore: The robe she was found in at Bắc Đình Thành, rewoven by the Vessel Hall with spirit silk and given back to her at her Trúc Cơ.
items.build_use: A young sword's guard and linh lực.

items.name: Snow Step (Tuyết Bộ Kiếm)
items.lore: Her master's first sword, plain and narrow, handed down when Sở Hàn Y matched her stance for a full day without moving.
items.build_use: Ice cuts that keep their stacks: the master's road.

items.name: Ice Knot Needle (Băng Kết Châm)
items.lore: A needle of black-cored ice she made herself; the core is not Ice at all, and she has never let a teacher hold it to the light.
items.build_use: Ice seals with a curse inside them.

items.name: Black-Backed Mirror (Hắc Bối Kính)
items.lore: A frost mirror backed with black lacquer, won at go from a Hắc Ngạn salt-trader. She shows the white face; the black face she keeps for herself.
items.build_use: Soul guard and longer Ice stacks for a patient caster.

items.name: Fisher's Sword (Ngư Kiếm)
items.lore: An ice-cutter's blade ground down to a sword by his master, the way his own was; Liễu does not know his master chose the steel from the ruin of Hàn Giang Môn.
items.build_use: A sword that outlasts: Cold hits and regeneration.

items.name: River Ice Gourd (Giang Băng Hồ)
items.lore: His grandmother's gourd, filled through an ice hole on the night she taught him the fallen sect's sitting; it has a lone fisher scratched on its neck.
items.build_use: Sustain for the sit between cuts.

sets.name: Ice Heart Regalia (Băng Tâm Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Keeper's Stillness (Chưởng Hồ Chi Tĩnh): while you hold all three, the first time each fight you would fall below a quarter of your health, the foe's clock stops for 1.5 s (its arts, basic attack and companions wait; no damage taken, your arts recharge), and the foe gains 3 Ice stacks.

sets.story: Tần held all three. The Mirror went to Tiết Hàn Mai in 820 for the Array's last nodes, and Sở Ngọc Hồ has never asked for it back. The Regalia is whole only in one pair of hands, so succession and Tiết's death decide who holds it.

sets.name: Red and White Plums (Hồng Bạch Song Mai)

bonuses.effect: Twin Plums (Song Mai): your Snow Plum cuts alternate swords; every fifth petal lands twice, and a petal that crits adds one more Ice stack.

sets.story: Lãnh Hương Các's two plum swords and the cape of its last swordsman, Phó Thanh Mai. The red was lost at Cô Thành in 726. Phó Ám Hương wears the white and his father's cape, and the set is whole only if he takes the red back from Phượng Minh.

sets.name: Glacier Vigil (Băng Bích Thủ Tịch)

bonuses.effect: The Peak Does Not Move (Phong Bất Động): while your diagram is laid and you are Composed, your ward gains 3 % of its base value each second, with no ceiling; each second you stay Composed past the tenth costs you 1 % of your linh lực. When the foe breaks it (a shield breaks), the foe gains 4 Ice stacks and cannot evade for 1 s.

sets.story: Two pieces from Tần Ngưng Sương, the banner from the Array's laying and the seal from her deathbed, and one Cố cut from her own cave wall. Cố has worn all three since 1010 and has not come down. Whoever she gives the seal to will learn the last order.

sets.name: Ice-Fisher's Three (Băng Ngư Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Second Wind on the Ice (Băng Thượng Hồi Khí): the first time each fight you fall below half health, you regain 20 % of your health and a quarter of your linh lực over 4 s, and your next five Snow Plum cuts each add one more Ice stack.

sets.story: Made by the coast for its own man: the blade forged at Trấn Sa from a fisher's ice-cutter, the coat from Đoàn's family, the gourd refilled by the villages. Thẩm wears all three in the Hall of Cold Law so the inner halls see what the coast pays.

sets.name: Keeper of the Lid (Thủ Cái Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Walk the Nodes (Tuần Tiết): while you stand inside your own formation, every 6 s it regains 4 % of its strength and you gain an Earth guard stack. Once a fight, at 10 Earth guard stacks, your formation cannot be broken for 3 s.

sets.story: Both cut from one locust tree of Hòe Âm, the wood sent by her childhood friend Thái Lê Tuyết when Tiết laid the Array's last nodes. She wears them with the Clear-Heart Mirror, which is the Keeper's, not hers.

sets.name: Clear Glaze (Lưu Ly Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Every Fifth a Star (Ngũ Tinh): each time a foe reaches 5 Ice stacks from you, your next cut against it is a sure crit and its Cold damage ignores the foe's ward.

sets.story: The sword and ring are the Keeper's gifts at her disciple's Kết Đan; the robe is Khương's own. She wears the set as an heir would, and asks every year why it is not the Regalia.

sets.name: Step for Step (Bộ Bộ Tương Tùy)

bonuses.effect: Master's Road (Sư Lộ): while your ward holds, the Ice stacks you put on the foe last twice as long.

sets.story: The robe she was found in and her master's first sword: the two things the Keeper has given anyone along with her surname.

sets.name: Black and White Stones (Hắc Bạch Tử)

bonuses.effect: Hidden Half (Ẩn Bán): each time a foe gains its fourth Ice stack from you, it is also cursed for 3 s, and your curses on it count as Ice debuffs for your stack effect.

sets.story: Made and won by her own hands, never issued by the Pavilion. A go player's pair: the white side shown, the black side kept.

sets.name: Fisher's Heirs (Ngư Gia Song Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Sitting on the Ice (Tọa Băng): after 2 s Composed, you regenerate 1.5 % of your health and linh lực each second, and your next cut adds 2 Ice stacks.

sets.story: One piece from his master and one from his grandmother, the Pavilion and the fallen sect. Liễu wears both and has told neither giver about the other.
